title: Repeated rightward sweep marks
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Boolean-tape Turing machine and $A$ a nondeterministic Boolean-tape Turing machine, with a Boolean loop parameter and input word $x$. For any natural number $m$, choice word $w$ of length at most $m$, input-head position, and simulated-machine tape contents and head positions, if the yard head starts at $m-|w|$, then running the host machine from phase $p1$ under $w$ leaves it in phase $p1$, advances each of $A$’s work-tape heads by $|w|$, places the yard head at $m$, and leaves the other tapes and output unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: Arbitrary simulated-machine tape contents and head positions
